## Checklist-accuracy findings / fixture gaps (record continuation)

Continuation of the run record above (`priority:P0`, 5b14b7f3). For the wave anchor card; not extracted.

**Checklist-accuracy**

- **access-security.write-path-guards** — steps[5] 'set an invoice to status paid': a PATCH {status:'paid',paid_on} on a draft answers 400 VALIDATION_FAILED 'Issued On is required' (requiredWhen); used the seeded paid INV-1003 instead — the step should say to use a seeded paid invoice or include issued_on+paid_on
- **access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only** — fixtures.requires asks for an OS_TENANCY_POSTURE=isolated boot, which 18.0 refuses at boot by design (serve.ts walledPostureRefusal: 18.0 supports 'single' only). The item cannot be live-run against an 18.0 server; its live clauses should be re-scoped to the single control or marked planned for the 18.x that lifts the…
- **access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only** — step 4 control: a minimal object body needs sharingModel or the save is refused 400 security-owd-unset
- **ai.mcp-stdio-fail-closed** — tools/list on the stdio transport names the run_action-free data tool set (9 tools incl. aggregate_records) — aggregate clauses runnable on this boot (knownGap not triggered)
- **api-backend.query-contract-matrix** — $select narrows to exactly the requested keys — no system identity keys (not even id) are added; step 5 says "plus system identity keys", which this build does not do (harmless, but the expectation text is looser than the behaviour)
- **api-backend.packaged-action-disabled-dispatch** — MCP run_action argument is `actionName`, not `action` (an `action` key is refused -32602 with a did-you-mean); step 6 does not name the argument
- **approvals.account-app-entry** — acceptance[6].verify says pick '中文（中国）' (zh-CN) and that the picker offers no bare zh entry; at this pin the INTERFACE picker (login-page globe menu) lists '中文' and sets html lang 'zh'; '中文（中国）' appears only in Profile → Preferred language, which the page itself says is the notification language, not the interface lan…
- **approvals.account-app-entry** — Persona is both submitter and finance approver of its own invoice; self-approval was permitted (can_act true). Item does not say whether that is intended — noted, not judged.
- **automation.packaged-flow-disable-durable** — GET /automation/‹flow>/runs caps limit at 100 (limit=200 → 400 VALIDATION_FAILED); not mentioned in steps
- **cli.dev-boot-contract** — Exit codes measured: plain dev SIGINT → 0 (×9), --fresh SIGINT → 130, no-config → 1, flag refusal → 2 — all as steps[8] states
- **cli.organization-ownership-ceremony** — ITEM STALE vs subject 5b14b7f3: 18.0 deliberately ships `os migrate organization-ownership` as a NOT_IMPLEMENTED refusal (fresh-installs-only ruling 6259608309; packages/cli/src/commands/migrate/organization-ownership.ts ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_UPGRADE_UNAVAILABLE). Clauses 1,2,4 and the checkpoint half of 3 describe a…
- **cli.organization-ownership-ceremony** — `os migrate comment-reactions --apply` still runs in 18.0 (not withdrawn): on cr.db with 2 planted sys_comment rows → run1 '2 converted', 1 not-JSON value listed, exit 1 (column cannot be dropped until every value reads); run2 '2 already converted, 0 converted' (idempotent), sys_comment_reaction holds 2 rows (dup user…
- **integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix** — driver id `mongo` is retired in spec 18 (build refuses it naming `mongodb`); probes must use driver: "mongodb"
- **platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render** — steps[5]/history say 45 Setup destinations (re-measured 2026-10-01); this boot serves 42 Setup leaves (8 Account matches). Item says recount each run — recorded 42.
- **platform-core.v18-boot-refusals** — step 1 says `os serve … -d file:COPY.db`: `serve` has no -d flag (INVOCATION ERROR — Nonexistent flag: -d); use OS_DATABASE_URL (or `os start -d`/`os dev -d`).
- **platform-core.v18-boot-refusals** — clause 2 'checksum before == after' is insufficient in WAL mode: the 18.x driver leaves changes in COPY.db-wal, so the main file can hash identical while the DB differs — compare a logical dump or checkpoint first.
- **platform-core.v18-boot-refusals** — step 2 `os dev` with DevPlugin services:{auth:false}: (a) defineStack refuses a DevPlugin instance under devPlugins (manifest shape), (b) under plugins it double-registers 'storage' inside os dev, (c) an os dev stack with no auth tier is refused earlier by the no-auth data-API refusal. The AuthzIdentityObjectsMissingE…
- **platform-core.v18-boot-refusals** — the refusal code ORGANIZATION_OWNERSHIP_MIGRATION_REQUIRED is not in the CLI output; the clause should match the message (tables + command) rather than the code literal.
- **records-forms.crud-roundtrip** — steps[2]/clause 0: the New form submits sales_region:'amer' (its default) even though the step fills only name/industry/status — expect that key in the POST payload.
- **studio-authoring.first-run-loop** — steps[3] quotes the publish toast as 'Published all drafts in this package (one atomic release)'; at this pin it reads 'Published 1 item in this package (one atomic release)' and the panel button is 'Publish all'.
- **studio-authoring.first-run-loop** — steps[2]: the picklist field is not saved until it has ≥1 option ('Not saved yet: the field "Status" needs at least one option') — the add-field step is add → fill options, then the draft save fires.
- **platform-core.serve-composition-v18** (seen from the P0 Tier 1 batch, item is v18) — the verify recipe omits `OS_TEST_TIERS=nightly`: `packages/cli/test/serve-organization-record-page.e2e.test.ts` is a nightly-tier file, so the recipe as written prints "FILTER SELECTED NOTHING" for it; with the switch: 1 file, 2 passed.

**Fixture gaps**

- **access-security.rls-both-sides** — D11 private write-up not available to this runner (known gap)
- **access-security.crud-permission-matrix** — clause 5 guest-anchor lane unobservable on stock boot (known gap)
- **access-security.walled-environment-metadata-operator-only** — walled posture (group/isolated) is refused at boot on 18.0 by design (serve.ts walledPostureRefusal, no escape hatch) — every walled clause is unrunnable on a live server in this release; only the kernel-level pins (bootStack) exercise it
- **cli.organization-ownership-ceremony** — no v17 DB fixture in the tree: minted one from npm @objectstack/cli@17.7.0 (`npm install` fails with arborist 'edgesOut' null; `pnpm add --ignore-workspace` works)
- **integration-system.datasource-credential-refusal-matrix** — acceptance[1] and [6] connect halves still need a reachable credential-protected postgres/mysql/mongo (unchanged knownGap)
- **platform-core.builtin-apps-nav-render** — Browse Marketplace catalog content: blocked(environment) — cloud registry egress denied (502 MARKETPLACE_PROXY_FAILED 'fetch failed'), per knownGap
- **platform-core.v18-boot-refusals** — no v17-shaped SQLite fixture in the tree; minted from npm @objectstack/cli@17.7.0 via `pnpm add --ignore-workspace` (npm install fails: arborist 'edgesOut' null)
